Postdoctoral Research Fellow - Environmental Science & Sustainability

content_sections.heading: About Amrita Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. The Coimbatore Campus department offers this postdoctoral fellowship to support active interdisciplinary environmental research, publication in peer-reviewed journals, and departmental research activities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants should have an excellent academic record with a strong publication profile in peer-reviewed journals. Demonstrated experience in conducting independent research, scientific writing, project execution, and interdisciplinary collaboration is essential. content_sections.heading: Amrita Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct interdisciplinary environmental research, publish SCI papers, prepare research proposals, mentor students, assist teaching, and support departmental research activities. Work with an active interdisciplinary research group developing sustainable solutions for environmental challenges.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Review the recruitment notification details and ensure you meet the PhD qualification and research requirements. Contact [email protected] for further details regarding the application process. Submit your application before the last date of October 31, 2026.
